cases.description: hunks[1].basis[0].evidenceId names no evidence record. A hunk basis is resolved at the wire stage (CEM-V1-017), before any references check, so this is wire/invalid-field.
cases.name: hunk-basis-unresolved

cases.description: hunks[0] appears a second time with the same ID. Hunk IDs are checked for repeats after runner receipt uniqueness and before any link is resolved, so this is references/duplicate-reference, not a later patch hunk count failure.
cases.name: hunk-duplicated

cases.description: criterionLinks[0].hunkIds holds the same unknown hunk ID twice. Uniqueness within each link array is checked before resolution, so this is references/duplicate-reference, not unresolved-reference.
cases.name: link-ids-duplicated-unknown

cases.description: A second, well-formed criterion binding is declared but no criterion link names it. Every declared criterion must be used; an unused declaration is references/reference-coherence, checked after every link has resolved.
cases.name: criterion-link-missing

cases.description: A second, well-formed runner receipt is declared but no criterion link names it. As for criteria, an unused runner receipt is references/reference-coherence.
cases.name: runner-link-missing

cases.description: The runner-plan artifact entry appears twice with the same path, digest and kind. A repeated artifact path or digest is references/duplicate-reference, checked before the artifact role closure.
cases.name: artifact-duplicated
